channel.title: lightGallery
channel.description: lightGallery supports features such as animated thumbnails, pinch / double tap to zoom, HTML5 videos, YouTube, Vimeo videos, social media share, rotate, fullscreen and many more.

item.title: lightGallery 3 is a complete rewrite, native in React, Vue and Angular
item.description: lightGallery 3 is a complete rewrite. One gallery, native in vanilla JavaScript, React, Vue and Angular on a shared headless core, with justified layout, origin crop, virtualization, video facades, custom icons, localization and RTL, and the 2.x API unchanged. What changed, what is new, and how to upgrade.
